_comment: DESIGN.md §10.1. M1 slice: base values only, upgrade ladders still empty (M3). The weapon should reliably kill one or two current-wave monsters unaided, and regen must undo chip damage on a full lane clear - together these set when the first player is eliminated (§5.5), target wave 13-15.
_armourNote: Not stated in DESIGN.md. The matrix applies in both directions (§6), so a monster hitting the fortress needs something to hit against. Plate is the obvious read for a fortress; change freely.

auras._comment: One active at a time, player-chosen. Strength and radius upgrade separately (§10.1). Not applied by the sim yet - M3.

resourceBuilding._comment: §10.2. Adjacent to the fortress, cannot be attacked. Produces gems.
